statement: The six low-type mapping-class groups, pure groups, orientation extensions, surface fundamental groups and their centres are computed with puncture and isotopy conventions explicit.
depends_on: Farb and Margalit, Proposition 2.3, Theorem 2.5, Sections 2.2.1--2.2.2 and 8.1; elementary centre and marked-torus arguments supplied
manuscript_passages (section; folio; sca: Prompt Rule 5 and After LM3 conventions; LM3 A.11 is a lead to section 19, folios 111--115, scans 222--230 and section 21, folios 129--131, scans 257--261; no new palaeographical claim
depends_on_doubtful_reading (scan, alter: No; conventions specified explicitly and table independently verified.
notes: Full oriented groups: 1,1,C2,SL2(Z),S3,SL2(Z); extended: C2,C2,C2^2,GL2(Z),S3 x C2,GL2(Z). The first four types are nonhyperbolic; (0,3),(1,1) are hyperbolic with different peripheral data. Discrete mapping classes are not scheme automorphism functors. No new finite test is needed for the proved elementary centre calculations.
